Word of the Day
Study
/ˈstʌdi/
VERB
To give attention to learning or understanding something
"I study for three hours every day to achieve my goals."
📖 Grammar Lessons
Present Simple — Simple Present
Used for habits and facts: I study every morning. | She studies at night. (+ s with he/she/it)
Present Continuous — Continuous Present
Used for ongoing actions happening now: I am studying now. | She is working on the project.
Present Perfect — Present Perfect
Used for experiences and past events related to present: I have studied 5 languages. | She has finished the task.
Past Simple — Simple Past
For completed events at a specific time: I studied yesterday. | She went to school. (Irregular verbs: go→went, see→saw)
Past Continuous — Past Continuous
For an action that was ongoing in the past: I was studying when she called. | They were playing all day.
Past Perfect — Past Perfect
For an event that happened before another past event: I had studied before the exam. | She had left before he arrived.
Will — Simple Future
For spontaneous decisions and predictions: I will study tomorrow. | It will rain tonight.
Going to — Future Intention
For pre-planned intentions: I am going to study medicine. | She is going to travel next week.
Future Continuous — Future Continuous
For an action that will be ongoing at a specific time: I will be studying at 8pm tomorrow.
A / An — Indefinite Article
A book (consonant sound) | An apple (vowel sound). Used for first mention or professions: She is a doctor.
The — Definite Article
For something known/specific: The book on the table. | The sun is hot. With superlatives: The best.
No Article — No Article
With general/abstract nouns: Water is essential. | Music is beautiful. | Love conquers all.
Can / Could — Ability & Permission
I can speak Arabic. (present) | I could swim when I was young. (past) | Could I borrow your pen? (polite request)
Must / Have to — Obligation
You must wear a seatbelt. (rule/law) | I have to wake up early. (personal necessity)
Should / Would — Advice & Wishes
You should study more. (advice) | I would love to travel. (wish) | Would you help me? (polite request)
Zero Conditional — Permanent Facts
If + present, present: If you heat water, it boils.
First Conditional — Likely / Possible
If + present, will + verb: If I study hard, I will pass.
Second Conditional — Unlikely Situations
If + past, would + verb: If I had a million dollars, I would travel.

© 2025 WeU — Smart Learning Platform | Version 1.0

About WeU

WeU is an all-in-one smart learning platform designed to help students and lifelong learners stay focused, motivated, and organised.

What WeU Offers

  • Study — Pomodoro timer, task manager, flash cards, quiz, and focus analytics
  • English — Vocabulary, grammar, listening, and conversation exercises
  • Body — Fitness tracking, yoga poses, and camera-based posture detection
  • Games — Educational mini-games including memory, math, and word challenges
  • Smart Reminders — Contextual alerts that keep you on track
  • PWA — Install on any device and use it offline

Our Mission

To make quality education accessible, engaging, and enjoyable for everyone — no matter where you are or what device you use.

Version

WeU v1.0 — Built with care for learners everywhere.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 2025

1. Information We Collect

WeU stores all user data locally on your device using localStorage. We do not collect, transmit, or share any personal information with third parties.

Data stored locally includes: username, study statistics (XP, streak, sessions), task lists, reminder preferences, and app settings.

2. No Account Required

You can use WeU without creating an account. If you choose to create a local account, your credentials are stored only on your device using a secure hash — they are never sent to any server.

3. Third-Party Services

WeU uses the following external services for specific features:

  • YouTube Embed — Video player. Subject to YouTube's privacy policy.
  • Google Translate API — Translation feature. Subject to Google's privacy policy.
  • MediaPipe — Pose detection, runs entirely in your browser.

4. Permissions

WeU may request the following browser permissions:

  • Notifications — For smart reminders (optional)
  • Camera — For camera-based fitness pose detection (optional)
  • Microphone — For voice commands (optional)

5. Children

WeU is suitable for all ages. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13.

6. Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. Continued use of WeU means you accept any updated policy.

7. Contact

Questions? Open the Contact section in WeU.

Contact Us

We love hearing from our users! Whether you have a bug report, a feature idea, or just want to say hi — reach out to us.

Send a Message

Terms of Use

Last updated: January 2025

1. Acceptance

By using WeU, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

2. Use of the App

WeU is provided for personal, non-commercial educational purposes. You may not copy, reverse engineer, or redistribute the app without permission.

3. User Content

Any content you create in WeU (tasks, notes, flashcards) is stored locally on your device and belongs to you.

4. Disclaimer

WeU is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We are not responsible for any loss of data or other damages arising from use of the app.

5. Changes

We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use constitutes acceptance of updated terms.
